text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: Retain P3 deferred milestone. Frame extraction has already occurred (docs/module-relations.md); the historical incubated-Frame wording below is superseded. Neither ntab nor group-ntab is in build.sbt. All five proposed work stages remain open and need current frame4s API/consumer revalidation. Their support and lineage principles remain useful, but this epic must not pull effort from core correctness, measured performance, or active PHRF. Reactivate only for a concrete workflow that the current domain and estimate-set APIs cannot adequately serve; reduce scope before implementation.
